May15
Arrive London
Friday, May 15 · London
London
9:15 AM
Arrive LHR T5 → Hotel via Tube
Immigration, collect bags, then take the tube — ~45 min door to door, £9.10 each with contactless. No tickets, no booking needed. Just tap and go.
🚇 Step-by-Step · Heathrow T5 → Hotel Indigo
1
After baggage claim — follow signs for Underground / Elizabeth line. Do not follow "Heathrow Express" signs — skip it, it's £37 and unnecessary.
2
Tap in at the turnstile with your contactless card or Apple Pay. £9.10 per person — no ticket needed, no app, just tap.
3
Board the Elizabeth line ELIZABETH — direction Abbey Wood or Shenfield. Ride to Ealing Broadway. About 22 min.
4
Exit at Ealing Broadway — follow signs to Central line, Platform 5 or 6. Don't tap out — it's a free transfer within the same fare.
5
Board the Central line CENTRAL — direction Hainault or Newbury Park (eastbound). Ride 5 stops to Shepherd's Bush. About 13 min.
6
Exit Shepherd's Bush — follow signs for Uxbridge Road. Tap out with the same card you tapped in with. Walk 0.2 miles (~6 min) to Hotel Indigo on Richmond Way.
⏱ Total: ~45 min
💳 Cost: £9.10 per person
🕙 Trains every 5–15 min

Rest & recharge

📝 Notes
May16
Full London Day
Saturday, May 16 · London
London
Morning
Borough Market — first meal of the day
Head out whenever you're ready. Take the Central line from Shepherd's Bush → St. Paul's (4 stops, ~10 min) — then walk down to the Millennium Bridge and cross on foot. The view of St. Paul's from the bridge is one of the best in London. Borough Market is a 5-minute walk from the south end of the bridge.
It's London's best food market and Saturday is peak day. Graze as you go — salt beef bagels, fresh oysters, Gujarati curries, Raclette, pulled pork buns, warm scotch eggs, artisan pastries. No plan needed, just wander and eat what looks good.
🍞 Borough Market · First meal · Whenever you're ready 🚇 Central line → St. Paul's · walk across Millennium Bridge
Afternoon
South Bank & beyond — go with the flow
You'll already be on the South Bank after the market. No agenda — just pick what appeals and wander. A few natural options from where you'll be:
🎨 Tate Modern — Free. Literally next door to the market. World-class modern art, great building. Even 45 min inside is worth it.
🌉 South Bank walk — Stroll west along the Thames toward Westminster Bridge. You'll pass the Tate, the National Theatre, the London Eye, and end up at Big Ben & Parliament. Postcard London. About 45 min of easy walking.
🏛 Trafalgar Square & National Gallery — From Westminster, a 10-min walk north. Free, excellent if you want an hour of something calm and impressive.
🎭 Covent Garden — Easy tube from anywhere on this route. Street performers, market stalls, good coffee. Lively on Saturdays.
Aim to wrap up sightseeing by ~4:00–4:30 PM to leave time to regroup at the hotel before Ledbury.
~4:30 PM
Optional — Graphic Bar (Soho) 🍸
If you're feeling it: Soho cocktail bar famous for gin cocktails served in customized paint tins — 5 colors, each a different recipe. Fun and photogenic. Walk-ins welcome, just one round and out by 5:00 PM. It's on the Central line back to Shepherd's Bush, so it fits naturally on the route home.
4 Golden Square, Soho, W1F 9HT  ·  Skip it entirely if you're tired — no pressure.
🍸 Graphic Bar · Soho · If you're up for it
~5:00 PM
Back to hotel — freshen up for Ledbury
Central line back to Shepherd's Bush. Get changed — Ledbury is smart casual. The restaurant is a 10-min walk from the hotel, so leave by 5:45 PM.
6:00 PM
Dinner — The Ledbury ⭐⭐⭐ ✓ Confirmed
Three Michelin stars. Chef Brett Graham, one of the finest restaurants in the UK. Seasonal British ingredients sourced from their own deer, Jersey cows, and Iberian pigs. Opened 2005, earned 3 stars in 2024. An exceptional meal.
✓ The Ledbury — 127 Ledbury Road, Notting Hill, London W11 2AQ · 6:00 PM BST
3 Michelin Stars · Chef Brett Graham · Smart casual dress
⭐⭐⭐ The Ledbury · Notting Hill · 6:00 PM

May20
Golf & Spa Day
Wednesday, May 20 · Mauritius
Golf + Spa
Morning
Breakfast at leisure
Early start for Marcus — fuel up at La Terrasse or grab something from L'Artisan. Gabby: slow morning, coffee on the terrace.
☕ L'Artisan / La Terrasse
Daytime
Marcus — Golf at Legend Course ✦ Hosted
Par-72 championship course designed by Hugh Baiocchi. Water hazards, sea breezes, and the iconic 17th hole — a par-3 over a coastal inlet. One of the best courses in the Indian Ocean region. Covered by Flexera as Marcus's selected activity. Attire: golf shoes, sunglasses, hat, nice shorts, collared golf shirt. Lunch on own or with the activity.
✦ Golf included by Flexera as selected activity
Daytime
Gabby — Guerlain Spa or Beach
Mauritius' only Guerlain Spa. Options: Imperial Relaxing Massage (60 min) or Tailor Made Facial. Spa access all day — hammam, hydrotherapy pool, relaxation lounge. Or spend the day at the pool / beach. Attire: casual clothing. Lunch on own or with the activity.
💆 Guerlain Spa or beach/pool

Restaurants & Experiences

Tap to mark as done — covers both Mauritius and London

🏝 Mauritius · One&Only Le Saint Géran
🍣
Resort · Japanese Fusion
Tapasake
On stilts over the lagoon. Hot-stone dishes, sashimi, ocean views at night. Do not skip. Book ahead.
🥩
Resort · Steakhouse
PRIME
Contemporary steakhouse — Mauritius' first upmarket cut. Regularly hosts Michelin-starred guest chefs.
🐟
Resort · Creole
La Pointe
Beachfront. Feet in the sand, catch of the day, ocean breeze. The most Mauritius restaurant on the resort.
🍳
Resort · All-Day
La Terrasse
Breakfast daily — tropical fruit buffet, live stations, freshly squeezed juices. Pool terrace views.
☕
Resort · Bakery
L'Artisan
Artisan bakery and coffee shop. Morning ritual — flat white and a pastry before the beach. Non-negotiable.
🌿
Resort · Mauritian
Le Badamier
Freshly caught seafood under trees overlooking the ocean. Authentic Mauritian flavors for lunch.
🌊
Resort · Italian
RIVA
Italian Riviera-inspired beachfront pool club. Light plates, cocktails, the most beautiful pool view.
🔥
Resort · Private
Glampfire Tipi Dinner
Private beach dining under a tipi with bonfire. Ask the concierge to arrange. Wildly romantic.
🇬🇧 London · Restaurants & Experiences
🍛
Restaurant · Curry
Dishoom
The London original. Chicken tikka masala — this is the dish. Black dal, chai. Queue early or book. Can't miss.
⭐
Restaurant · Michelin
1890 by Gordon Ramsay
Michelin starred inside The Savoy. Lunch tasting ~£90, dinner ~£175. Book well ahead. Stunning room.
⭐⭐
Restaurant · 2-Michelin
Bonheur by Matt Abé
Brand new 2-Michelin-star. Took over the Le Gavroche site in Mayfair. Classical French technique, incredible buzz.
🏙
Restaurant · Views
RGR High · 60th Floor
12-seater at 22 Bishopsgate's 60th floor. Panoramic London views, new Michelin star 2026. Intimate and dramatic.
🧀
Experience · Market
Borough Market
London's best food market. Saturdays are peak. Cheese, charcuterie, pies, international stalls. Must do.
🚲
Experience · City
City Bike Tour
Hyde Park → Buckingham Palace → Westminster → Tower Bridge → Thames Path. Best way to see London fast.
📅 Saturday May 16 · Daytime
🍞
Bakery · East London
The Dusty Knuckle
Cult artisan bakery in a converted car park in Dalston. Born as a social enterprise employing at-risk youth. Order the Egg Chilli Cheese Focaccia — spicy pickled green chillies, fresh herbs on house-baked focaccia. Also: beef birria and chicken caesar on the rotating sandwich menu. Open 8am–3:30pm. About 35 min from Notting Hill by tube — best as a Saturday morning trip before Borough Market.
Abbot Street Car Park, Dalston E8 3DP · Nearest tube: Dalston Kingsland

One&Only Le Saint Géran · Belle Mare Peninsula · East Coast

🏝 Overview

Private peninsula jutting into the Indian Ocean, with the lagoon on one side and open ocean on the other. The most spectacular resort location in Mauritius. Breakfast included daily at La Terrasse.

🍽 Dining & Venues
La Terrasse — All-Day Dining
Adjacent to main pool. Breakfast here every morning (included). Tropical fruit buffet, live stations, freshly squeezed juices. Pool terrace views.
PRIME — Contemporary Steakhouse
Inside main building. Evening only. Mauritius' first upmarket steakhouse, regularly hosts Michelin-starred guest chefs.
Tapasake — Japanese Fusion ⚠️ CLOSED TUESDAYS
On stilts over the lagoon. Hot-stone dishes, sashimi, tasting menus, stunning ocean views at night. Book ahead — most popular dinner on the resort.
La Pointe — Beachfront Creole
Follow beach path east. Catch of the day, Creole spices, feet in the sand. Most authentically Mauritian of the resort restaurants.
Le Badamier — Mauritian Seafood Lunch
Near beach under tropical trees. Authentic Mauritian flavors, freshly caught seafood. Lunch spot with local character.
L'Artisan Bakery — Morning Coffee
Near lobby. Artisan pastries, flat whites, fresh bread. Morning ritual before the beach. Open from early morning.
RIVA — Italian Beachfront Pool Club
Italian Riviera-inspired. Beachfront pool, light plates, cocktails, and the most spectacular ocean view on the property.
🌿 Spa & Activities
Guerlain Spa
Garden area, follow spa signs from lobby. Mauritius' only Guerlain Spa — hammam, hydrotherapy pool, relaxation lounge. Signature massages and facials.
Club One Fitness
Adjacent to spa. Full gym, padel courts, tennis courts, yoga pavilion. Open from 6 AM.
Boathouse / Watersports
Lagoon beach. Kayaks, paddleboards, snorkel gear, water skiing, glass-bottom boat trips. Catamaran pickup Thu May 21 at 8:45 AM from here.
Infinity Pool
Main pool adjacent to La Terrasse. Ocean-horizon infinity edge. The centrepiece of the resort.

💡 Good to Know
  • Check-in 2pm, Check-out 12pm — ask about late checkout if needed
  • Breakfast included daily at La Terrasse — don't miss it
  • Resort casual throughout — event-specific attire listed in the Dress Code Guide (Plantation Chic Wed, Beachside Chic Thu)
  • Currency: Mauritian Rupee (MUR). Exchange at airport or use card at resort
  • Credit cards accepted at all resort venues — Visa and Mastercard widely accepted
  • May weather: 68–81°F, dry season, minimal rain, water 26°C (79°F). Highs in the low 80s°F, lows in the high 60s/low 70s°F. Perfect weather. Light layers recommended for evening events.
  • Tipping: not mandatory but appreciated. Small rupee tips for housekeeping
  • English and French both widely spoken across Mauritius
  • Tapasake is CLOSED Tuesdays — plan accordingly
  • Concierge can arrange private beach dinners, sunset cruises, and helicopter transfers
